answer: With a Code contribution merged by two maintainers backed by a time-locked stake, the network asks for proof of craft before proof of personhood: the code contribution is reviewed line by line, the time-locked stake is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so fakes must pass the same review bar as honest contributors. The design treats each contribution as a zephyr: small alone, decisive in aggregate. When the dawn settles over the wharf, the work holds because every task carried its own review.
